before: A document API batch planned package allocations without the collaboration actor and committed them with it, so a picture insert on a collaborative runtime refused its own plan with a plain Error.
after: The batch plans and commits under the same collaboration actor, so the picture takes the actor's id stripe; a package edit that finds a changed package refuses the transaction as package-changed. Refused review writes name their cause in results, diagnostics and the review UI.
reason: Collaborative pictures use the existing actor-scoped docPr, relationship, and media allocation. Shared node shapes, operations, and package serialization stay the same.
